items.title: AI Class ASEAN: AI for Youth
items.description: Completed all 15 chapters (12 hours) of the AI learning modules for youth on AIClassASEAN.org, from AI basics, ethics, and data privacy to generative AI, prompting, and building simple AI-based tools.

items.title: Belajar Dasar Pemrograman Web
items.description: Competency certificate for Dicoding's 41-hour web programming fundamentals class: HTML structure and semantic elements, CSS styling and layouting, and pages that work well on mobile, closed with a final exam and a website project. Valid until August 2029.

items.title: AI Ignition Training
items.description: A 30-hour training from AI basics to breakthrough: productivity tools, prompt engineering, generative AI, large language models, and responsible AI. Part of the AI Opportunity Fund: Asia Pacific with AVPN, supported by Google.org and the Asian Development Bank.

items.title: DigiUp: Digital Marketing
items.description: A digital training and certification program from Telkom Indonesia that prepares vocational students for the needs of the digital industry. Completed with the grade Certified.

items.title: Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) Prep Course
items.description: A fundamental AI training program from Microsoft Azure that prepares participants to take and pass the AI-900 certification.

items.title: Estha.AI: From Students to Creator
items.description: Certificate of appreciation for taking part in the webinar on leveraging AI to address school needs. Estha is a no-code platform for building AI-powered apps such as chatbots and assistants.
